digest.headline: US Treasury yields hit 19-year highs as the Federal Reserve established a stablecoin capital floor and Saudi Aramco slashed crude prices.

lede.b: Government borrowing costs reached a 19-year high this week as rising oil prices drove United States Treasury yields higher. A yield is the return an investor gets on a bond, which is a loan made to a government or company. The yield on the 10-year Treasury hit 5.228% and the 30-year Treasury yield rose above 5.5%. At the same time, the Federal Reserve set a stablecoin capital floor to target vulnerabilities in digital token arrangements. Barr, a Federal Reserve official, flagged run risks and anti-money laundering gaps.
lede.i: United States Treasury yields climbed to 19-year highs driven by advancing oil prices, with the 10-year yield hitting 5.228% and the 30-year yield exceeding 5.5%. Concurrently, the Federal Reserve established a stablecoin capital floor to address vulnerabilities in digital token arrangements. Federal Reserve official Barr flagged run risks and anti-money laundering gaps during the policy announcement. Higher US yields provided strong support for the greenback as the dollar held firm in the lower 157 range against the Japanese yen.
lede.a: Government borrowing costs reached a 19-year high, propelled by advancing oil prices, with the 10-year Treasury yield touching 5.228% and the 30-year yield rising above 5.5%. The Federal Reserve established a stablecoin capital floor on Friday, with official Barr flagging run risks and anti-money laundering gaps to mitigate structural vulnerabilities in digital token arrangements. This yield surge underpinned the greenback, keeping the dollar anchored in the lower 157 range against the Japanese yen.

thread.a: Advancing energy prices drove sovereign yield curves higher across major jurisdictions. Central banks simultaneously adjusted liquidity operations and currency stabilization measures amid divergent equity index trajectories.

United States of America.label: United States
United States of America.sub: Treasury yields hit highs and stablecoin capital floors set

stories.t: Treasury Yields Climb as Oil Prices Advance
stories.b: Government borrowing costs reached a 19-year high this week. A bond is an official IOU issued by the government, which pays regular interest to investors. Rising oil prices drove US Treasury yields higher. The yield on the 10-year Treasury reached 5.228%. The 30-year Treasury yield climbed above 5.5%.
stories.i: Government borrowing costs reached a 19-year high this week. Rising oil prices drove US Treasury yields higher. The yield on the 10-year Treasury hit 5.228%. The 30-year Treasury yield rose above 5.5%.
stories.a: Sovereign borrowing costs touched a 19-year peak this week. Higher crude prices pushed yields higher across the curve, driven by expectations of persistent input cost pressures. The 10-year Treasury yield settled at 5.228%. The 30-year Treasury yield moved above 5.5%.

stories.t: Federal Reserve Establishes Stablecoin Capital Floor
stories.b: The Federal Reserve established a stablecoin capital floor. A stablecoin is a digital currency designed to keep a steady value, usually pegged to a traditional currency like the dollar. Federal Reserve official Barr flagged run risks and anti-money laundering gaps. These rules apply to the digital asset sector.
stories.i: The Federal Reserve set a stablecoin capital floor. Federal Reserve official Barr flagged run risks and anti-money laundering gaps. These regulatory measures target vulnerabilities in digital token arrangements. The central bank announced the policy updates on Friday.
stories.a: The Federal Reserve instituted a formal stablecoin capital floor. Policymaker Barr highlighted structural run risks and anti-money laundering compliance gaps inherent in digital asset intermediaries. The macroprudential framework addresses systemic liquidity vulnerabilities within tokenized liabilities.

stories.t: US Equities Rise as Nasdaq Gains 0.39%
stories.b: US stocks turned higher during the trading session. The Nasdaq index rose by 0.39%. An index is a basket of different company shares that tracks how a market segment is doing. Bloom Energy stock surged following alignment with S&P 500 and AI power deals.
stories.i: US equities turned higher as the Nasdaq index rose 0.39%. Bloom Energy stock surged as S&P 500 inclusion prospects and artificial intelligence power agreements aligned. Oracle links supported Bloom Energy as the top S&P 500 performer.
stories.a: US equities reversed earlier losses to trade higher, with the Nasdaq advancing 0.39%. Bloom Energy shares surged to become the top S&P 500 performer, catalysed by AI infrastructure power agreements connected to Oracle. PayPal and Bloom Energy led market gains.

politics.b: Federal Reserve officials discussed banking rules and digital asset risks on Friday. Central bankers oversee the financial system and set monetary policy. Regulatory agencies monitor stability across the economy.
politics.i: Federal Reserve officials addressed regulatory parameters for digital assets and capital requirements on Friday. Policymakers monitor financial stability risks across traditional and digital banking sectors. Supervisory agencies enforce anti-money laundering standards.
politics.a: Federal Reserve supervision focused on digital asset vulnerabilities, stablecoin capital floors, and systemic run risks. Regulators maintain oversight on banking sector capital adequacy and financial integrity. Policymakers balance macroprudential mandates with market developments.

stories.b: An index is a list of company stocks grouped together to track how a market is doing. Stocks are shares of ownership in a company. Companies like Atlassian, Pola Orbis Holdings, and Daiwa Office Investment face exits from FTSE indexes. These removals can change how many investors buy or sell their shares.
stories.i: Global equity benchmarks are shedding several prominent names. Atlassian, Pola Orbis Holdings, and Daiwa Office Investment are facing departures from FTSE indexes. These index exclusions force institutional funds tracking those benchmarks to adjust their holdings accordingly.
stories.a: Constituent deletions from major FTSE series create forced rebalancing flows for passive investment vehicles. Atlassian, Pola Orbis Holdings, and Daiwa Office Investment now trade at valuations reflecting their impending exclusion. Arbitrageurs must weigh the liquidity mismatch against the fundamental fair value discount implied by the index departure.

Germany.sub: German equities rise at close while sentiment weakens

stories.t: German Equities Close Higher
stories.b: Stock markets are places where parts of companies are bought and sold. The DAX index is a group of major company shares in Germany. It measures how those companies are doing overall. The DAX finished higher at the end of the trading day. It gained 0.51% by the close of trade.
stories.i: The DAX index finished the session in positive territory. German equities recorded a gain of 0.51% by the closing bell. This upward movement capped a mixed week for Frankfurt trading.
stories.a: The blue-chip DAX index registered a 0.51% advance at the cash close, concluding a volatile weekly sequence. Order flow tilted toward buyers into the final hour, pushing the benchmark higher despite conflicting domestic indicators. Price action on the index reflects ongoing positioning adjustments heading into the final sessions of the month.

stories.t: Consumer Outlook and Individual Stock Movements
stories.b: Consumer sentiment in Germany is expected to worsen soon. Sentiment is how people feel about spending money and the economy. Meanwhile, individual company shares also moved on the stock exchange. MLP stock was traded on the Xetra system. It reached EUR 9.670, which is an increase of 0.62 percent.
stories.i: German consumer sentiment is projected to worsen in upcoming periods. Across individual listings, MLP stock traded on Xetra last changed hands at EUR 9.670. That price represented a 0.62 percent increase during the session.
stories.a: Forward-looking consumer sentiment surveys point toward deterioration in domestic household confidence. Microeconomic data showed MLP shares gaining 0.62 percent to print at EUR 9.670 on the Xetra venue. These divergent indicators highlight the friction between corporate equity valuations and household economic expectations.

Japan.label: Japan
Japan.sub: Nikkei surges, currency moves, and trade pressure

stories.t: Nikkei Stock Average Rises for Fifth Consecutive Session
stories.b: The Nikkei Stock Average is a major index, which is a basket of prominent company shares tracking the stock market. The Nikkei Stock Average surged 850 yen today. This increase marks the fifth straight gain for the index. The two-session week finished higher by 1,345 yen.
stories.i: The Nikkei Stock Average surged 850 yen to secure its fifth straight gain. This market advance brought the total two-session weekly rise to 1,345 yen. Investors pushed prices higher as upcoming rate events loom next week.
stories.a: The Nikkei Stock Average advanced 850 yen for a fifth consecutive gain, capping a 1,345 yen two-session weekly increase. Positioning adjusts ahead of domestic rate events scheduled for next week.

stories.t: Dollar Holds in Lower 157 Range as Yields Support Greenback
stories.b: The dollar is the currency of the United States. A yield is the return an investor gets on a bond, like the interest paid on a loan. The dollar held firm in the lower 157 range against the Japanese yen. Rising United States yields provided support for the exchange rate.
stories.i: The dollar held firm in the lower 157 range against the Japanese yen. Rising United States yields provided strong support for the greenback. Meanwhile, the dollar dipped slightly elsewhere as oil prices eased.
stories.a: The dollar maintained firmness in the lower 157 range against the yen. Rising United States yields anchored the currency pair. Broader greenback momentum softened slightly as crude oil prices eased.

politics.b: Trump raised concerns over the weak yen during talks in Japan. Japan also flagged potential currency intervention to support its money value. Communities in Japan are dealing with a rise in foreign births.

Separately, Japanese communities face rising challenges in coping with an increase in foreigner births.
politics.a: Trump raised concerns regarding the weak yen and its implications for bilateral trade during discussions in Japan. Japanese officials flagged intervention risks as G7 yield movements focus attention on currency levels. Local communities confront operational pressures from rising foreigner birth rates.

China.label: China
China.sub: Yuan stability, gold futures expansion, and AI projects

stories.t: PBoC Maintains Yuan Stability Amid Dollar Movements
stories.b: The central bank, which is the state institution that manages a country's money and interest rates, kept the Chinese yuan broadly stable against the dollar. Société Générale reported this currency action on 25 September 2026. The dollar gained strength against the yuan following yield moves in G7 nations. The People's Bank of China managed the currency value despite wider foreign exchange shifts.
stories.i: The People's Bank of China kept the yuan broadly stable against the advancing dollar according to Société Générale on 25 September 2026. G7 yield moves drove currency focus as the dollar gained on the yuan. The inflation and interest rate environment prompted broad foreign exchange adjustments. The central bank intervened to anchor the official rate against external pressures.
stories.a: Société Générale noted the PBoC maintaining a stable yuan fix against the advancing USD on 25 September 2026. G7 yield differentials continue to dictate cross-border capital flows, testing the PBoC's daily band management. The transmission from core sovereign yield curves to emerging Asia FX underscores persistent carry trade unwinding risks.

stories.t: Hong Kong Prepares Yuan-Denominated Gold Futures
stories.b: Hong Kong will launch a new gold futures contract priced in yuan. FXStreet reported this upcoming exchange offering on 25 September 2026. This contract gives traders a new way to buy and sell gold using Chinese currency. The launch expands financial products tied to the yuan outside mainland China.
stories.i: Hong Kong announced plans to launch a yuan-denominated gold futures contract on 25 September 2026 according to FXStreet. This derivative product broadens offshore yuan liquidity pools. Market participants can trade gold exposure directly in Chinese currency. The contract deepens financial market infrastructure in the special administrative region.
stories.a: FXStreet reported the upcoming launch of a yuan-denominated gold futures contract in Hong Kong on 25 September 2026. The instrument expands offshore RMB clearing utilities and pricing mechanisms for precious metals. Arbitrage desks can now hedge onshore-offshore gold spreads more efficiently. The contract adds depth to the growing suite of yuan-settled commodities.

stories.t: China Generates 222,000 AI Video Projects in Six Months
stories.b: Chinese creators launched 222,000 artificial intelligence video projects in half a year. Mezha reported this production milestone on 25 September 2026. The rapid output shows massive growth in digital media technology. Tech developers across the country continue to scale automated video creation tools.
stories.i: China produced 222,000 artificial intelligence video projects over a six-month period. Mezha published these industry figures on 25 September 2026. The surge reflects broader adoption of generative models in commercial media production. Domestic technology firms are scaling automated tools to meet rising digital content demand.
stories.a: Mezha reported that domestic entities completed 222,000 artificial intelligence video projects within six months on 25 September 2026. The metric highlights the rapid commercialisation of generative video architectures in the region. Infrastructure providers continue to absorb high compute workloads to sustain this output. The expansion demonstrates broad diffusion across domestic media supply chains.

politics.b: Chinese leader Xi Jinping spoke about bilateral ties with Donald Trump on 25 September 2026. Asia Nikkei reported that the Chinese leader described future relations as brighter during their summit. Both leaders discussed diplomatic and economic matters.
politics.i: Xi Jinping stated that bilateral ties with Donald Trump would be brighter during a summit covered by Asia Nikkei on 25 September 2026. The leadership meeting addressed major geopolitical points between the two nations. Observers tracked the high-level dialogue for potential shifts in trade policy.
politics.a: Asia Nikkei covered the Trump-Xi summit on 25 September 2026, where the Chinese leader characterised bilateral relations as brighter. The diplomatic engagement set the baseline for executive-level negotiations on trade and security. Market participants monitored the joint statements for potential tariff rollbacks or enforcement changes.

India.label: India
India.sub: RBI liquidity auctions and treasury sales alongside indices

stories.t: Stock Indices Bounce While Nifty Extends Weekly Losses
stories.b: The BSE Sensex index, a collection of major company shares, went up by 315 points to reach 73,895.74. This rise came from investors buying blue-chip banking, oil and gas, and auto stocks at lower prices. Meanwhile, the Nifty index recorded its seventh consecutive weekly loss. This matches the longest losing streak since the Covid-19 crash in 2020.
stories.i: The BSE Sensex gained 315 points to close at 73,895.74 following value buying in blue-chip banking, oil and gas, and auto equities. Conversely, the Nifty index registered its seventh straight weekly decline. This performance marks the longest weekly losing streak for the index since the Covid-19 crash in 2020.
stories.a: Equities rebounded as the BSE Sensex rose 315 points to 73,895.74 on selective value buying across heavy-weight banking, oil and gas, and auto sectors. Simultaneously, the Nifty extended its weekly downturn to a seventh consecutive period, matching its longest losing run since the March 2020 market dislocation.

stories.t: Central Bank Announces Variable Rate Reverse Repo Auction
stories.b: The Reserve Bank of India announced an overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo auction. The central bank manages money supply in the banking system through these operations. The notified amount for the auction is ₹2,00,000 crore. The auction window opens on September 28, 2026, with a reversal date set for the following day.
stories.i: The Reserve Bank of India scheduled an overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo auction under the liquidity adjustment facility. The central bank set the notified amount at ₹2,00,000 crore for the operation. Bidding takes place on September 28, 2026, ahead of the reversal on September 29, 2026.
stories.a: The Reserve Bank of India activated liquidity management operations by scheduling an overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo auction. The facility absorbs ₹2,00,000 crore from the banking system on September 28, 2026. Settlement and reversal occur the following day.

stories.t: Reserve Bank Outlines Treasury Bill and Debt Issuance Calendars
stories.b: The Reserve Bank of India scheduled a treasury bill auction for ₹24,000 crore across 91-day, 182-day, and 364-day tenors. State governments also offered to raise ₹22,200 crore through various state securities. Additionally, the federal government's Ways and Means Advances limit is set at ₹50,000 crore for the second half of the financial year.
stories.i: The Reserve Bank of India set a ₹24,000 crore treasury bill auction spanning 91-day, 182-day, and 364-day debt instruments. State governments scheduled auctions to raise an aggregate ₹22,200 crore via dated securities. Furthermore, the federal Ways and Means Advances limit was established at ₹50,000 crore for October 2026 through March 2027.
stories.a: Primary issuance schedules released by the Reserve Bank of India detail a ₹24,000 crore treasury bill auction across standard tenors alongside a ₹22,200 crore state government securities offering. Simultaneously, the federal Ways and Means Advances borrowing limit was fixed at ₹50,000 crore for the second half of fiscal year 2026-27, with market loan floatation triggers linked to 75% utilization.

politics.b: State governments offered to sell stock through auctions to raise funds. The federal government coordinated debt issuance calendars with the central bank. Officials published borrowing limits for the upcoming fiscal half-year.
politics.i: State administrations offered stock via auctions to raise an aggregate ₹22,200 crore. The central bank and the federal government released issuance calendars for marketable dated securities and treasury bills. Authorities fixed the Ways and Means Advances limit at ₹50,000 crore.
politics.a: State governments slated ₹22,200 crore in security auctions across multiple tenors. Coordinated debt management frameworks between the central bank and the federal government established issuance calendars for marketable securities and treasury bills. The federal Ways and Means Advances ceiling was capped at ₹50,000 crore for the period spanning October 2026 to March 2027.

Saudi Arabia.label: Saudi Arabia
Saudi Arabia.sub: Saudi Aramco contracts, pipeline restoration, and oil pricing

stories.t: SLB Expands Operations With New Saudi Aramco Contracts
stories.b: SLB is a big company that provides oilfield services, which means it helps energy producers drill and find oil. SLB just won major new contracts from Saudi Aramco, the giant state-owned oil company of Saudi Arabia. These new deals let SLB expand its footprint and do more work inside Saudi Arabia. Aramco awards these jobs as it keeps developing its massive energy resources. SLB secured these wins following competitive bidding processes.
stories.i: Oilfield services provider SLB secured major contracts with Saudi Aramco to expand its operational footprint in Saudi Arabia. Aramco awarded the new work packages as part of its ongoing domestic infrastructure and extraction programs. SLB integrates these new wins into its existing Middle Eastern portfolio. The agreements strengthen SLB's local presence within the kingdom's energy sector.
stories.a: Oilfield services firm SLB expanded its operational footprint via multiple contract wins with Saudi Aramco. The awards solidify SLB's market share in the kingdom's upstream sector amid regional supply adjustments. Margin realization on these projects depends on local content compliance and equipment deployment schedules. The contracts reinforce the service provider's revenue concentration in Middle Eastern operations.

stories.t: Saudi Aramco Restores East-West Pipeline Near Yanbu
stories.b: Saudi Aramco has finished fixing and restoring the East-West pipeline. This crucial energy pipe crosses the country to move oil. Crews brought the pipeline back online as war risks moved closer to the coastal city of Yanbu. The pipeline gives Saudi Arabia a way to move oil without relying entirely on maritime shipping lanes. Aramco completed the restoration work to protect its export routes.
stories.i: Saudi Aramco restored operations on the East-West pipeline as regional war risks closed in on the terminal city of Yanbu. The pipeline provides a vital overland transit route across the kingdom for crude exports. Reactivating this conduit reduces reliance on maritime chokepoints during periods of heightened geopolitical tension. Aramco completed the repairs to secure continuity for its international shipments.
stories.a: Saudi Aramco brought the East-West pipeline back online as kinetic war risks approached Yanbu. The pipeline infrastructure reroutes crude away from vulnerable maritime lanes, mitigating structural supply chain disruptions. This operational adjustment provides redundancy for export logistics under heightened security threats. Flow rates through the restored conduit reestablish a critical bypass for maritime transport risks.

stories.t: Saudi Arabia Implements Steepest Arab Light Price Cut in Decades
stories.b: Saudi Arabia lowered its official selling price for Arab Light crude destined for Asia. This reduction marks the biggest price drop for this grade in over two decades. State oil producer Aramco adjusts these prices monthly to match global demand and market competition. Asian refiners receive these official prices ahead of their monthly purchases. The massive price cut follows weaker demand forecasts issued by OPEC.
stories.i: Saudi Arabia slashed the official selling price for Arab Light crude destined for Asia, marking the largest reduction in over two decades. State producer Aramco adjusts these pricing markers monthly to reflect prevailing regional refining margins and crude competition. Asian buyers received the new pricing schedules ahead of their term cargo allocations. The steep discount aligns with broader reductions in OPEC global demand forecasts.
stories.a: Saudi Arabia lowered the official selling price for Arab Light destined for Asia by the largest margin in over twenty years. State-controlled Aramco recalibrated its pricing formula to defend market share against competing non-OPEC barrels in Asian refining hubs. The aggressive price adjustment responds to softening prompt physical differentials and downward revisions in global demand growth. Importers absorbed the revised price structure amid shifting regional balance sheets.

politics.b: Saudi Aramco signed an LNG supply deal with Caturus. Meanwhile, Iraq pressed OPEC for a higher oil quota to offset decades of conflict losses. The UAE exited OPEC, drawing a public welcome from Donald Trump. Separately, the UN General Assembly hosted a meeting between Belize Prime Minister Briceño and the OPEC Fund CEO.
politics.i: Caturus signed an LNG supply deal with Saudi Aramco. Iraq pressed OPEC for a higher oil quota to offset decades of conflict losses. The UAE completed its exit from OPEC, receiving a public welcome from Donald Trump. Meanwhile, Belize Prime Minister Briceño met the OPEC Fund CEO at the UN General Assembly to discuss future development projects.
politics.a: Caturus executed an LNG supply agreement with Saudi Aramco. Iraq formally pressed OPEC for an increased production quota to offset historical conflict losses. The UAE formalized its exit from OPEC, eliciting a public endorsement from Donald Trump. Concurrently, Belize Prime Minister Briceño met with the OPEC Fund CEO during the UN General Assembly to deliberate on future development financing.

Nigeria.label: Nigeria
Nigeria.sub: Exchange rates, power revenues, and refinery share sales

stories.t: CBN adjusts foreign exchange benchmarks as naira trades near N1,329
stories.b: The Central Bank of Nigeria sets new exchange rates for foreign currencies like the dollar, pound, and euro. The naira trades at N1,329 per dollar at the official market window. Meanwhile, the parallel market holds near N1,380 per dollar. These rates track the value of Nigerian money against foreign money.
stories.i: The Central Bank of Nigeria updates official exchange rates for major currencies including the dollar, pound, and euro. The naira registers a marginal weakening to N1,329 per dollar at the NAFEM window. Across the parallel market, the exchange rate hovers near N1,380 per dollar.
stories.a: The Central Bank of Nigeria recalibrates benchmark valuation rates for hard currencies as the NAFEM spot rate prints at N1,329 per dollar. Divergence persists against the parallel market where quotes remain anchored around N1,380 per dollar. Market participants monitor these spreads for arbitrage opportunities under the ongoing foreign exchange framework.

stories.t: Investors subscribe billions to Dangote Refinery initial public offering
stories.b: Investors buy billions of naira worth of shares shortly after the Dangote Refinery IPO opens. Aig-Imoukhuede confirms the fast subscription pace. An IPO is when a private company sells shares to the public for the first time.
stories.i: Investors inject billions of naira into the Dangote Refinery IPO within minutes of its opening. Aig-Imoukhuede confirms the rapid capital uptake following the primary market launch.
stories.a: Primary market demand materializes rapidly as investors commit billions of naira within minutes of the Dangote Refinery IPO opening. Aig-Imoukhuede verifies the immediate absorption of the offering. This order book velocity signals strong institutional and retail liquidity for domestic equity issuances.

politics.a: Peter Obi signals continuity with the current administration by committing to preserve Tinubu's forex liberalisation framework. This stance outlines the political consensus forming around currency policy among leading contenders.

Australia.label: Australia
Australia.sub: ASX 200 closes lower while currency movements react to rates

stories.t: Australian Stocks Slip as S&P/ASX 200 Index Finishes Lower
stories.b: The S&P/ASX 200 index is a list that tracks the value of the two hundred biggest companies on the Australian share market. Shares represent small pieces of ownership in a business. This index dropped by 0.43% by the end of the trading day. The stock market in Australia finished lower overall at the close of trade.
stories.i: The S&P/ASX 200 benchmark index dropped 0.43% by the final bell. Local equities followed a downward trajectory as the main board closed in negative territory. Share prices across multiple sectors declined during the session.
stories.a: The S&P/ASX 200 index declined 0.43% by the close of trade. Broad-based selling pressure drove domestic equities lower during the session. Market participants absorbed the negative finish across the primary Australian benchmark.

stories.t: Australian Dollar Rebounds Against the Greenback After RBA Rate Outlook
stories.b: The Australian dollar is the official currency used in Australia. A currency is the money system of a country, and its price goes up and down compared to other currencies like the American dollar. The Australian dollar bounced back from 0.7000 against the US dollar. This recovery happened because the US dollar eased following a strong week, while expectations for interest rate hikes from the Reserve Bank of Australia also shaped the currency outlook.
stories.i: The Australian dollar recovered from the 0.7000 level against its US counterpart. The greenback eased following a strong week of gains in global currency markets. Meanwhile, expectations for monetary tightening from the Reserve Bank of Australia continue to shape foreign exchange forecasts.
stories.a: The Australian dollar rebounded from 0.7000 as the US dollar retreated from recent highs. Reserve Bank of Australia rate hike expectations continue to provide fundamental support for the currency pair. stories.t: EQ Resources Enters ASX 300 Index Following Nevada Tungsten Deal
stories.b: EQ Resources is a mining company that just joined the ASX 300 index. An index is a group of stocks put together to measure how a market is doing. The company gained access to a United States tungsten joint venture through a restart deal in Nevada.
stories.i: EQ Resources secured entry into the ASX 300 benchmark index. The promotion coincides with the company acquiring access to a US tungsten joint venture. This expansion follows a restart agreement finalized for a project in Nevada.
stories.a: EQ Resources gained inclusion in the ASX 300 following operational developments in North America. The corporate milestone coincides with the company securing operational access to a United States tungsten joint venture via a Nevada restart agreement.
